## What is left

PR #31070 gives the no-footer rule a home on the PR-body door: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md` L32 (「PR 正文不送页脚…」) sits under the door line L31. Three pointers to that door still carry their own copy of the rule:

1. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md` L17: `(`seat-post-protocol.md` 正文行,不送页脚)`.
2. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` L290: `⇒ 该正文改走 `seat-post-protocol.md` 的 PR 正文行,不送页脚。`
3. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` L313 (the `Metadata-protocol:` row): `…through the PR-body line of `references/seat-post-protocol.md`, with no footer (`references/platform-readings.md`)`.

Each copy can drop its own spelling and only point to the door, so the rule has one home (AGENTS.md, one home per rule). All three edits shorten lines and change no line count. This finishes S1 of the PR #31058 review.

Line numbers are as on `main` after PR #31070 lands; re-read before editing.

**Level:** internal agent tooling (`.claude/**`), `skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
